summary: In a developer search, the hyperscaler pool (Google, Meta, Microsoft) produced zero approved profiles: candidates carry significant unvested equity and sit at senior levels with expectations above the role's scope, so hyperscalers are a low-conversion pool for developer roles. Real estate developers were the largest source (96 of 156 active), then renewables (47) and DC developers (13); confirmed industrial developers are a narrow pool (23).

source.subject: Hyperscaler talent converts poorly into developer roles
